extra.reason: Proven by committed executable real-server probe (44e68b8): REST/session lifecycle, SSE required events, plugins, fork/fresh inheritance, Git worktree scoping, compaction, restart, and bounded shutdown all verified on Kilo 7.5.6; unsupported SDK/fork assumptions documented with alternatives.

Scaffold committed (0ce44eb): typed src/, executable factory CLI with help/version/unknown handling, Kilo PluginModule export with id 'kilo-factory', noninteractive check gate (typecheck+build+test), 6 unit/artifact tests pass, npm pack dry-run produces 6-file package. No daemon framework introduced.

Typed Kilo adapter committed (c0564af, 1656e00): RestKiloAdapter implements health, listSessions, getSeedConfiguration, createJobSession (fresh from exact seed agent/model/id), promptAsync (parts only, no model overrides), abort, delete, subscribe with idempotent event dedup and reconnect backoff, and close. Uses proven REST/SSE surface with explicit directory scoping per job worktree. 16 unit tests + 3 real-server contract tests pass.

Config + state schema committed (dae75a5): project-agnostic config types (roles, validation, main branch), SQLite-backed durable state store with job generation fencing, state transitions, attempts, failure classification, deterministic upsert/update with stale-generation guard. 8 new tests pass. DB is project-local and reconstructible.

Beads backend adapter committed (6d96943): BeadsCliBackend uses JSON CLI output for ready/show/claim/update/close. Core scheduler parses structured JSON. Ready excludes epics. Idempotent operations reconcile on failure. 10 unit tests cover malformed JSON, empty results, and races.

Worktree manager committed (6f9f96b): GitWorktreeManager creates/inspects/cleans job-isolated worktrees with factory/<jobId>/<generation> branches. Dirty work never force-reset. Cleanup refuses unknown/unowned. Deterministic unique commit detection. 3 unit tests + contract tests pass.

Coordinator FSM committed (09e8ad7): reconciliation-based lifecycle with explicit state machine, monotonic generation fencing, bounded retries, failure classification. Legal transitions encoded, illegal fail closed. Idempotent across restart. No blind redispatch. 12 new tests pass.

Version/capability guard committed (a7af470): detects unsupported Kilo versions early, checks required API/plugin capabilities, fails with actionable diagnostics, feature-gates experimental hooks. 4 unit tests pass.

Plugin contract committed (bf909ed): validates job identity and generation for completion/block payloads, rejects stale generations and job mismatches, structured machine-readable tools. 5 unit tests pass.

Artifact verifier committed (4e9a8cd): independently verifies plugin completion claims against Git and durable state. Rejects wrong job/generation/SHA/dirty contradictions. Stale generations never reach integration. 4 unit tests pass.
